item.text: [{"task_id":"1e5d6875","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    colors = [int(round(v)) for v in params['colors']]","    side = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    cells = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    unit = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if side < 1 or cells < 1 or unit != 1:","        return out","    h, w = grid.shape","    for k in range(len(params['directions'])):","        color = colors[k + unit]","        paint = colors[k + unit + len(params['directions'])]","        direction = int(round(params['directions'][k]))","        for r in range(h - side + unit):","            for c in range(w - side + unit):","                block = grid[r:r + side, c:c + side]","                if np.count_nonzero(block == color) != cells:","                    continue","                missing = np.argwhere(block != color)","                if len(missing) != unit:","                    continue","                mr, mc = missing[0]","                if block[mr, mc] != colors[0]:","                    continue","                dr = (side * int(mr) - unit) * direction","                dc = (side * int(mc) - unit) * direction","                for pos in np.argwhere(block == color):","                    rr = r + int(pos[0]) + dr","                    cc = c + int(pos[1]) + dc","                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:","                        if grid[rr, cc] == colors[0]:","                            out[rr, cc] = paint","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[5],"geometry":[3],"directions":[2]},"params":{"colors":[7,5,2,4,3],"geometry":[2,3,1],"directions":[1,-1]},"rationale":"Each three-cell L gains a translated copy, clipped at grid boundaries. Gray Ls produce yellow copies shifted diagonally toward their missing corner; red Ls produce green copies shifted diagonally in the opposite direction. Original cells are preserved."}]
